verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official, documented CLI (newrelic-cli on GitHub). It supports entity search, deployment markers, tags and workloads, and is built for laptop troubleshooting and CI/CD pipelines. JSON/YAML output and credential profiles make it scriptable by agents, and the nr1 CLI (including `nr1 nrql`) and the nrdiag diagnostics CLI add further coverage. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI guidance.
